prompts.v1: You are Helio's support assistant. Answer the support agent's question in at most 3 sentences.
prompts.v2: You are Helio's support assistant. Answer the support agent's question in at most 3 sentences. Start with the one thing the agent must tell the customer, then the next step.

kb.text: Helio bills monthly plans on the 1st of each month in UTC.
Annual Helio plans are invoiced up front and renew on the signup anniversary.
Failed card payments are retried on days 3, 5 and 7 before the workspace is paused.
Helio invoices show VAT only for customers with an EU billing address.
Customers can switch between monthly and annual billing from Settings > Billing at any time.
Seat changes made mid-cycle are prorated to the day on the next invoice.
Helio refunds monthly plans in full within 14 days of the charge.
Annual plans are refundable pro rata within 30 days of renewal.
Refunds after the refund window need approval from the support lead (Rosa Lind).
Refunds go back to the original card and take 5 to 10 business days to appear.
Partial refunds for unused seats are not offered on monthly plans.
A refund closes the workspace unless the customer downgrades to Free first.
SSO is available on the Business and Enterprise plans only.
Helio supports SAML 2.0 SSO with Okta, Azure AD and Google Workspace.
Before enabling SSO, at least one workspace owner must keep a password login as a break-glass account.
SCIM provisioning is Enterprise-only and needs SSO enabled first.
Enforcing SSO signs out every member who has not linked an identity within 24 hours.
SSO domain verification uses a DNS TXT record that must stay in place.
Workspace owners can export all invoices as a CSV or a ZIP of PDFs.
Full data exports are emailed as a download link that expires after 72 hours.
Exports larger than 2 GB are split into numbered parts.
Deleted workspaces can be exported for 30 days after cancellation.
The export includes attachments only when 'Include files' is ticked.
API-created records are included in exports the same as UI-created ones.
The Helio API allows 60 requests per minute on the Team plan.
The Business plan API limit is 300 requests per minute.
Enterprise API limits are set per contract, starting at 1,000 requests per minute.
Rate-limited API calls return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
API keys are scoped to one workspace and can be read-only or read-write.
The Helio API is versioned by date; the current version is 2026-07-01.
Webhooks are retried with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.
Every webhook carries an X-Helio-Signature header signed with HMAC-SHA256.
A webhook endpoint is disabled after 100 consecutive failures.
Webhook payloads are capped at 256 KB; larger events send a fetch URL instead.
Customers can replay any webhook from the last 7 days in the developer console.
Webhook events arrive at least once, so receivers must de-duplicate by event id.
Helio has four plans: Free, Team, Business and Enterprise.
The Team plan costs 12 dollars per seat per month billed monthly.
The Business plan costs 24 dollars per seat per month and adds SSO and audit logs.
The Free plan is limited to 3 seats and 50 invoices per month.
Enterprise adds SCIM, a custom DPA and a named account manager.
Nonprofits get 40 percent off Team and Business with a verified registration.
Helio keeps audit logs for 1 year on Business and 7 years on Enterprise.
Deleted invoices stay in the trash for 30 days before permanent deletion.
Backups are kept for 35 days and cannot be restored per customer.
Closed workspaces are purged 90 days after cancellation.
Customers can request early deletion of a closed workspace by emailing privacy@helio.example.
Email delivery logs are kept for 30 days.
Helio hosts data in the US (Virginia) or the EU (Frankfurt).
The data region is chosen at signup and cannot be changed later.
EU-region workspaces keep backups inside the EU.
Support staff outside the EU can access EU workspaces only with customer consent.
The EU region launched on 2025-03-01; older workspaces are all in the US.
Enterprise customers can request a dedicated region in Sydney.
Helio support hours are 08:00 to 20:00 UTC on weekdays.
Business plans get a 4-hour first-response target; Team plans get 1 business day.
Enterprise customers have 24/7 support for severity-1 incidents.
Status updates for incidents are posted at status.helio.example every 30 minutes.
Support tickets auto-close after 7 days without a customer reply.
Phone support is available only to Enterprise customers.

questions.say: A Team customer on a monthly plan asks for a refund 20 days after the charge, and wants a copy of their data first. What do we tell them?
A Team customer wants to switch on SSO with Okta tomorrow. What do we tell them?
A Business customer's webhook endpoint was down for about 60 hours over the weekend. Which events will still arrive, and how do they get the rest?
A customer whose workspace was created in 2024 wants their data moved to Frankfurt. Can we do that?

must.re: cannot|can't|can not|not possible|unable|isn't possible|is not possible
must.label: the region cannot be changed

questions.say: A Business customer's IT team asks whether Helio can create and remove user accounts automatically from Okta. Can it?
A customer cancelled 40 days ago and now asks for an export of their data. What can we do?

must.label: exports only for 30 days after cancellation

questions.say: A Team customer had a severity-1 outage on Saturday night and wants to phone us. What do we tell them?
A registered nonprofit with 10 seats asks what the Business plan would cost them per month. What is the price?
